problems.statement_en:
A domino is a 2× 1 or 1× 2 tile. Determine in how many ways exactly n2 dominoes
can be placed without overlapping on a 2n× 2n chessboard so that every 2× 2 square contains at
least two uncovered unit squares which lie in the same row or column.

Let n, m be integers greater than 1, and let a1, a2, . . . , am be positive integers not
greater than nm. Prove that there exist positive integers b1, b2, . . . , bm not greater than n, such that
gcd(a1 + b1, a2 + b2, . . . , am + bm) < n,
where gcd(x1, x2, . . . , xm) denotes the greatest common divisor of x1, x2, . . . , xm.
